parameters.targetAudience: Small to medium businesses, various industries

trendsIdentified.application: Features sections, service overviews, portfolio displays
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Use CSS Grid in Elementor via Container widget with grid layout. Set asymmetric column spans for visual interest.

trendsIdentified.application: Section entrances, stat counters, parallax backgrounds
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Use Elementor Motion Effects with Entrance Animation. Set viewport trigger. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

trendsIdentified.application: Cards, modals, overlays on colorful backgrounds
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Requires custom CSS (backdrop-filter). Performance impact on older devices. Use sparingly.

trendsIdentified.application: Typography system, hover effects on text
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Requires font that supports variable axes. Good for performance (single file). Limited Elementor UI support - may need custom CSS.

trendsIdentified.application: Site-wide theme toggle, respecting user preference
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Requires custom CSS with CSS variables. JavaScript for toggle. Not native in Elementor - needs custom implementation.

trendsIdentified.application: Button hovers, form field focus, loading states, success feedback
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: CSS transitions for most cases. Elementor hover state settings. May need custom CSS for complex interactions.
Easy to implement with Elementor typography settings. Requires careful responsive handling.

trendsIdentified.application: Dynamic content based on user behavior
trendsIdentified.implementationNotes: Requires significant backend setup. Elementor Dynamic Tags can support basic personalization.

referenceSites.name: Stripe
referenceSites.relevance: Overall design direction, hero patterns, scroll animations

referenceSites.name: Linear
referenceSites.relevance: Modern SaaS design patterns, dark mode, micro-interactions

sectionResearch.recommendedPattern: Centered hero with gradient background, prominent headline, dual CTAs, and optional logo cloud below
sectionResearch.elementorApproach: Full-height Container with Flex layout, centered alignment, background gradient, Heading + Text + Button widgets

sectionResearch.recommendedPattern: 3-column grid with icon boxes, hover lift effect, benefit-focused headlines
sectionResearch.elementorApproach: Container with Grid layout, Icon Box widgets, hover shadow effect via Elementor settings

sectionResearch.recommendedPattern: Testimonial cards in carousel or grid, with full attribution and specific results
sectionResearch.elementorApproach: Testimonial Carousel widget or manual Container layout with Image + Text widgets

sectionResearch.recommendedPattern: Contrasting section with transformation headline, large CTA button, supporting reassurance text
sectionResearch.elementorApproach: Container with contrasting background, centered layout, Heading + Button widgets

sectionResearch.recommendedPattern: 3-column pricing with middle tier highlighted, toggle for billing period, clear CTAs per tier
sectionResearch.elementorApproach: Price Table widget or custom Container layout with Toggle for billing period (requires custom code)

recommendedApproach.visualDirection: Clean, modern professional with generous whitespace, subtle animations, and clear hierarchy
avoidPatterns: Text over busy images without overlay
recommendedApproach.colorApproach: Use brand primary for CTAs and key accents. Neutral grays for text and backgrounds. Semantic colors for feedback states.
recommendedApproach.typographyApproach: Modern sans-serif for body, optional serif for display headlines. Clear size hierarchy with generous line height.
recommendedApproach.animationApproach: Subtle fade-in on scroll for sections. Hover states for interactive elements. 200-300ms transition duration. Respect reduced motion preference.

decisionsInfluenced: Template uses gradient hero backgrounds as default
Features section supports bento grid layout option
Scroll animations enabled via Elementor Motion Effects
entries.notes: This baseline research establishes the design direction for the template. Individual projects should conduct their own trend research for industry-specific patterns.
